title: Book of Ancient Secrets
contents: bullet | Available starting at level 3 (once you gain your Pact Boon).
bullet | Your Book of Shadows can hold ritual spells.
bullet | Choose two 1st-level rituals from any class; they appear in the book. With the book in hand, you can cast them as rituals.
bullet | You can cast any warlock spell you know with the ritual tag as a ritual.
bullet | Add more rituals you find (spell level ≤ half your warlock level, rounded up): copying takes 2 hours/level and costs 50 gp/level in inks.

title: Pact of the Tome
contents: text | You receive a Book of Shadows at the end of a short or long rest.
bullet | Choose 3 cantrips from any class’s list; while the book is on your person, you can cast them at will. They count as warlock cantrips and don’t count against cantrips known.
bullet | The book is a spellcasting focus for your warlock spells.
bullet | If lost, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony during a short/long rest to replace it; the previous book is destroyed.

title: Pact of the Blade
contents: text | As a Bonus Action, conjure or bond with a Simple or Martial Melee weapon. Use it as a Spellcasting Focus.
text | You can use your Charisma modifier for attack and damage rolls, and choose to deal Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or normal damage.
text | Bond ends if you use this feature again, the weapon is >5 ft away for 1+ min, or you die.
footer | Warlock | Pact Boon | Blade Bond

title: Pact of the Chain
contents: text | Learn Find Familiar. Cast it without a spell slot as a Magic Action.
text | Familiar can be a special form: Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Skeleton, Slaad Tadpole, Sphinx of Wonder, Sprite, Venomous Snake.
text | When you Attack, you can let your familiar attack using its Reaction.

title: Find Familiar
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (incense & herbs worth 10 gp, consumed)
text | Summon a spirit familiar (celestial, fey, or fiend) that takes an animal form. It acts independently but obeys you; it can’t attack.
bullet | Telepathy within 100 ft; as an action, see/hear through it until your next turn (you are blind/deaf to your own senses).
bullet | Cast a touch spell through the familiar if it’s within 100 ft (your attack/save DC).
bullet | Action: dismiss into a pocket space; action: resummon. Recast to change its form.
bullet | In combat it rolls its own initiative and takes its own turns; no Attack action.
footer | Spell | 1st level | Book of Ancient Secrets

title: Detect Magic
contents: text | Sense the presence of magic within 30 ft for the duration.
bullet | If magic is present, you can use your action to see faint auras around visible creatures/objects and learn each school of magic.
bullet | Moves with you; reveals ongoing spells and magical items through their auras.
bullet | As a ritual, casting time is 10 minutes longer (no slot).
